name: Société Arabe Internationale de Banque S.A.E

ratios.label: Net margin
ratios.withheld_reason: Withheld: the revenue for FY2025 is not in the statement file (only the profit is), so no margin can be built for the period the net_profit belongs to. The earlier figure was the margin of a different period.

valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.peRouteNote: the two P/E routes differ (market cap over net profit 2.78, price over EPS 3.42); the net-profit row reconciles with the filing's own profit before tax less tax, so the EPS row is the one filed in a different unit
valuation.ps_withheld_reason: Withheld: revenue is not on file or not positive for FY2024. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: EBIT and net debt are not both on file for FY2024, so EV/EBIT cannot be built. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.pePeriodNote: P/E and the income multiples stand on FY2025, the newest annual earnings on file; the balance-sheet multiples stand on FY2024
